rationale: The stock has already gapped up ~13.4% on strong earnings and is trading at 87% of today's range near the session high, with the last candle showing a sharp drop from 665.53 to 663.20 suggesting near-term selling pressure. The 9-EMA ($665.52) is above current price ($662.25), indicating the short-term momentum has turned slightly negative, while the wide bid-ask spread (30 bps) and post-gap exhaustion dynamics make risk/reward unfavorable for either direction — a long risks chasing an extended move with deteriorating momentum, and a short risks fighting strong fundamental tailwinds from the earnings beat and raised guidance.
